content: Sampling profilers need many samples per thread for statistical validity (flame graphs). Hang-triage folklore ('3 dumps, identical = stuck') is falsified on pool-heavy servers where idle workers are designed to look frozen (measured: 98.9% identical on a healthy server). Reliable at N=2: per-signature population deltas, taxonomy-gated same-TID persistence in non-idle buckets only. Needs N>>2: leaf-frame churn, statistical time-in-state.
